<tool_call>
<function=generate_character_profile>
<parameter=character_name>
Sophia
</parameter>
<parameter=profession>
High-flying corporate lawyer
</parameter>
<parameter=key_traits>
Icy demeanor, fierce negotiation skills, ambitious, driven by a need to prove her worth
</parameter>
<parameter=backstory_elements>
Family's tarnished reputation, shadows of family legacy
</parameter>
<parameter>motivations>
Prove her worth beyond family's tarnished reputation, redefine ideas of success and family loyalty
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
